name: What steps are involved in converting a standard shower to curbless?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in converting a standard shower to curbless?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting to a curbless shower involves several key steps. First, the existing shower area and floor structure are demolished. Next, the subfloor is carefully modified and sloped towards the drain to ensure proper water flow without a curb. A comprehensive waterproofing system is then installed to protect against leaks. After plumbing adjustments and inspections, the new tile is laid, followed by grouting. Finally, the shower fixtures, glass panels, and any accessories are installed, completing the seamless design.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes demolition, subfloor modification for sloping, extensive waterproofing, tile installation, and fixture setup.
